answer: Our thesis demonstrates Sybil attacks fail. We deploy recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments in an open agent garden ensuring cryptographic weight. Pairing verifiable randomness and verifiable delay primitives yields a Byzantine canyon wherein cloning diverges. Cryptographic information-theoretic unforgeability masks transformations. Finality acts as an immutable lotus, using verifiable proofs to reach Byzantine fault tolerance. Thus, cloning remains computationally infeasible.
